hypothesis: For genuinely composed two-stage intervention mechanisms whose stage operator identities appeared individually in FIT but whose combinations never did, an eight-address native learned tokenless policy trained using only public chosen-action histories can select informative interventions and generalize to new compositions. Require gain over matched random, low-count, fixed, trained GRU/MLP controls; compare with a public Bayesian information-gain expert, old-context retention and whole-process cost. No claim of broader causal discovery from a synthetic benchmark.

source.structural_mechanism: Three independent binary treatments A,B,C; intervene do(A=a,B=b,C=c), hidden mediator Z=op1(A,B), observed signed outcome Y=2*op2(Z,C)-1 then independent deterministic-key flip probability 0.15. Stage1 and stage2 are hidden Boolean operators chosen for each context; no direct Z/outcome counterfactual observation. The actor sees offered A/B/C vectors and own previously chosen Y signs. Sealed unrelated final query treatment shown only after six chosen probes per context. Source is synthetic with explicit structural equations, not real-world causal grounding.
source.train_compositions: All 36 ordered pairs from operators cartesian product EXCEPT each pair whose complete three-factor truth table matches ANY eight reserved unseen composition masks. This leaves 27 FIT operator pairs, 22 distinct FIT truth tables, zero heldout truth-table overlap; every primitive occurs in both positions in FIT. VALID uses FIT combinations, never reserved unseen.

training.native_policy: New trained shared per-candidate scorer over 8-address public chosen feedback count/sum, proposed 3-bit treatment and phase/step; no access to latent graph, private operator label, query outcome, unchosen rewards, or oracle target at inference.
training.fit_trajectories: All 3 models trained on identical public FIT randomized chosen interventions, 176*2*6=2112 public states/seed, analytic expected all-36-compositional-templates Bayesian posterior information gain targets on two currently offered interventions. Teacher/IG reference has stronger hand-coded hypothesis class and is disclosed, and does NOT pass private law identity or heldout answers to learner.
fixed_controls: native learned with physical feedback signs blinded for action selection
training.matching: Same public candidate pairs and per-world action budget, same FIT training histories/targets/updates for 3 trainable arms, all final prediction heads use one common fixed all-36-operator Bayesian evidence readout, no future query or unchosen feedback. Record different trainable parameters, wall time and compute limitations.
training.native_inference: New integer Q=384 quantized scorer with 8-address public vector inputs and integer hard-swish, signed nearest; reuse R112 portable-source preadmission lessons. Require strict source-bound Linux/Windows action, score and parameter hash equality, not floating-score tie control.

report_per_arm_per_seed: full process CPU and trainable parameter counts
public oracle IG and no-feedback controls
all 15 frozen criteria, no retrospective retuning
evaluation.cross_platform: Require all native quantized weight hashes, native complete action hashes, integer correct counts, control outcomes, native action divergence, cold restore mismatches and frozen criterion values match exactly across Linux/Windows; if any drift preserve NO-GO/PARITY_FAIL even if CI workflows green. Floating GRU/MLP drifting is science portability failure, not waived.
